findings.title: Schedule type display is computed then discarded
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config and, when schedule_type is present, replaces it with get_schedule_type_display() so the occurrence context would show a human-readable schedule type. The returned dict ignores that copy and sets "config" to monitor_environment.monitor.config, the original mapping. The converted value is never sent, so issue occurrence monitor context keeps the raw schedule_type (typically an integer) instead of the display string the code just computed.
